notes: Lineup format. Type 2 ('perde shiny por 1 segundo') is an illustrated gag instead of the sh-muk twist, so the same print isn't reused in 091; the only print is beach-while-bot-farms (photo with strangers pixelated + 2 real Earth Stone alarms + 'Enquanto bot moie / Eu tô na praia kkkk'), all from one customer. Meters (tendinite MAX, sorte 0%, bateria 1%) are obvious jokes, not statistics. End card asks 'Qual número é você?' with 1-2-3-4 chips. Added a 'com KizuBot' chip on card 4 so first-time viewers know what is farming at the beach.
